name: FABLE
description: FABLE is an extensible benchmark designed to assess large language models' understanding of data flow using structured procedural text. It adapts eight classical data-flow analyses from software engineering across three real-world domains, providing a diagnostic evaluation of data-flow reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A recent diagnostic benchmark for data-flow reasoning in LLMs that has attracted research interest, but it is still relatively new and not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Includes 8 classical data-flow analyses instantiated across 3 domains; first diagnostic benchmark for data-flow reasoning in LLMs.
